race.powerlevelling.saiyan.lore: Warriors who grow stronger each time they nearly die. Proud, loud, and always looking for a bigger fight.
race.powerlevelling.half_saiyan.lore: Raised between two worlds, carrying a warrior's fire without a warrior's pride. Learns fast and wakes up angry.
race.powerlevelling.human.lore: Ordinary people with extraordinary patience. No tail and no spark, just stubborn effort that adds up faster than anyone expects.
race.powerlevelling.namekian.lore: Calm, green-skinned healers who channel ki with unhurried precision. Their antennae pick up shifts in the ki around them.
race.powerlevelling.frost_demon.lore: Cold, patient conquerors of frozen worlds. Their ki hits hard, their skin shrugs off blows, and their tails never leave them.
race.powerlevelling.majin.lore: Pink, elastic and unpredictable, able to shrug off wounds and surprise its foes. Its grin is wider than its patience.
race.powerlevelling.android.lore: Built rather than born, with a steady engine for ki and little need for sleep. Efficient, precise, and always recharging.
race.powerlevelling.custom_template.lore: Placeholder race for designers. Hidden from players.
ki_nature.powerlevelling.balanced.desc: No strong edge: a little more mastery and EXP, nothing given up.
ki_nature.powerlevelling.reservoir.desc: High ki: a deep well that refills fast, at the cost of raw punch.
ki_nature.powerlevelling.volatile.desc: Glass cannon: every ki blast hits harder, and everything hits you harder back.
ki_nature.powerlevelling.bulwark.desc: Tank: built like a wall, slow to chase and slow to charge.
ki_nature.powerlevelling.ferocious.desc: Brawler: fists first, ki second, and quick to get its breath back.
ki_nature.powerlevelling.tempest.desc: Speed: a blur with endurance to spare, fragile up close.
ki_nature.powerlevelling.serene.desc: Calm ki: quick to refill and charge, but its blasts sting less.

item.powerlevelling.rebirth_orb.lore: A swirling orb that echoes with the potential of a thousand lifetimes.
attack.powerlevelling.meteor_core.desc: Hold to gather a huge orb overhead, release to hurl it. Slows as it grows, detonates in a wide blast that shoves everything away.
attack.powerlevelling.pinpoint_lance.des: A fingertip beam: a faint line shows your aim, then one instant shot pierces up to three targets.
attack.powerlevelling.repulse_wave.desc: A shockwave around you: damages and launches enemies, shatters their ki blasts, and makes you briefly untouchable. Usable while being hit for double ki.
attack.powerlevelling.crescent_saw.desc: A spinning saw of ki forms above your palm and is thrown out. It cuts everything on the way out and again on the way back; catch it for a ki refund and a faster cooldown. A wall turns it around early.
attack.powerlevelling.hailstorm.desc: Hold to unleash a stream of small ki shots from alternating hands. The fire rate ramps up, you move slowly while firing, and repeated hits on one target do less and less.
attack.powerlevelling.seeker_swarm.desc: Mini orbs gather around your hand, then fan out and curve towards the target near your crosshair. Dodge sideways or break line of sight to shake them.
attack.powerlevelling.ki_grenade.desc: Hold to set the throwing power, release to lob a grenade. It bounces once, blinks faster and faster, then detonates in a big blast that knocks enemies into the air. Walk out of the ring.
attack.powerlevelling.torrent_cannon.des: Hold to cup a roaring orb at your hip, release to unleash a huge sustained beam. It lags behind your aim, roots you in place and drains ki every tick, pierces everything in a line and shatters what it ends on. Press again to cut it short. Unlocks at level 20.

config.powerlevelling.auraParticleWispsT: Maximum energy wisps while transforming (particle system). Default 0 - AuraLayer renders wisps. Set >0 only for extra particle wisps.
config.powerlevelling.auraParticleWispsS: Max energy wisps in combat stance (particles)
Maximum energy wisps in combat stance (particle system). Default 0 - AuraLayer renders wisps. Set >0 only for extra particle wisps.
config.powerlevelling.auraParticleRocksC: Maximum ground rocks lifted while charging (subtle debris). Default 2. AuraLayer also renders ground flare.
config.powerlevelling.auraParticleRocksT: Maximum ground rocks lifted while transforming. Default 3.
config.powerlevelling.auraParticleLargeR: Maximum large rocks while charging (high intensity only). Default 0.
Maximum large rocks while transforming. Default 1.
config.powerlevelling.auraParticleGround: Ground ring spawn chance while charging (particles)

Ground ring spawn chance while transforming (particles)
Chance (0-100) per tick for ground rings (particle system). Default 0 - AuraLayer handles rings. Set >0 only for extra particle rings.

Chance (0-100) per tick for ground rings in Super Saiyan (particle system). Default 0 - AuraLayer handles rings. Set >0 only for extra particle rings.
config.powerlevelling.auraParticleDebris: Maximum debris particles when starting to charge (particle system). Default 0 - AuraLayer renders ground flare. Set >0 only for extra particle debris.
